Inspired by Fiji's rivers, mountains and waterfalls, the resort…

name: Novotel Nadi
desc: Touch down to 4-star comfort, a 5-minute drive from the airport, 10 minutes to Nadi Township and 20 minutes to Port Denarau for boat transfers to the islands. Novotel Nadi hotel offers air-conditioned guest rooms and facilities suitable for both families and the business traveler, with restaurant and conference venues overlooking 42 acres of tropical gardens. With a dip in the pool , and breakfast on the garden…
address: Namaka Hill, P O Box 11133, Nadi Airport

name: The Sebel Fiji Nuku Loaloa
desc: Discover a new way to stay at the 4 star The Sebel Fiji Nuku Loaloa in vibrant Wailoaloa, Nadi. Perfect for business or leisure, especially longer stays, this lifestyle resort offers fully self-contained accommodation blending modern comfort with wellness and recreation. Guests can enjoy spacious apartments and villas alongside facilities including a pool, gym, spa, sauna, pickleball court, and dining experiences…
address: Cnr Nadi Bay Rd Wailoaloa Rd, Nadi, Fiji

name: Tribe Na Tomba Fiji
desc: Tribe Na Tomba Fiji is a contemporary Denarau Island resort offering modern Fiji accommodation, stylish hotel rooms, spacious two-bedroom apartments, family-friendly facilities, conference and event venues, restaurants, bars, swimming pools and a 24-hour fitness centre. Conveniently located near Port Denarau and Nadi International Airport, the resort is ideal for family holidays, group travel, business events…

name: Mercure Nadi
desc: Mercure Nadi is set within five acres of beautiful tropical gardens and is located only minutes away from Nadi Airport. The hotel offers 85 spacious rooms, all surrounding an inviting tropical style swimming pool, offering ideal Nadi accommodation for couples or families looking for a tropical Fijian getaway. Mercure Nadi also features Rokete Restaurant and Bar for delicious Breakfast and Bar snacks.

name: Novotel Suva Lami Bay
desc: Suva's renewed waterfront destination for family focused executives and life balanced seekers to meet, stay, and create events, conferences and weddings. Located in sheltered Lami Bay, only minutes to central Suva with spacious ocean and garden view rooms with twin or king bedding. Time is well spent whether it be spent lounging poolside or connecting in the open plan lobby with picturesque views and all-day dining
